sentences.text: Dalam suratnya, Rudi menulis bahwa dia punya firasat buruk sebelum pindah kota.
sentences.en: In his letter, Rudi wrote that he had a bad feeling before moving to another city.
sentences.ko: 루디는 편지에 다른 도시로 이사하기 전에 불길한 예감이 들었다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Rina punya firasat bahwa aplikasi baru mereka akan laku di kalangan mahasiswa.
sentences.en: Rina has a hunch that their new app will be popular among university students.
sentences.ko: 리나는 새 앱이 대학생들 사이에서 잘될 거라는 예감이 들어요.

sentences.text: Rudi mengaku sempat merasa tertekan di tahun pertama kuliah.
sentences.en: Rudi admitted he felt pressured in his first year of university.
sentences.ko: 루디는 대학 첫해에 압박감을 느꼈다고 털어놓았어요.

sentences.text: Tim pengembang merasa tertekan menjelang tenggat peluncuran.
sentences.en: The development team felt under pressure as the launch deadline approached.
sentences.ko: 출시 마감이 다가오자 개발팀은 압박감을 느꼈어요.

sentences.text: Teman lama Rudi, Bayu, merasa prihatin membaca kabar banjir di kampungnya.
sentences.en: Rudi's old friend Bayu felt concerned reading news of the flood in his village.
sentences.ko: 루디의 오랜 친구 바유는 루디 고향의 홍수 소식을 읽고 걱정했어요.

sentences.text: Para investor tampak prihatin melihat biaya server yang terus naik.
sentences.en: The investors looked concerned seeing the server costs keep rising.
sentences.ko: 투자자들은 서버 비용이 계속 오르는 걸 보고 걱정스러운 표정이었어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menutup suratnya dengan kalimat "Untuk sahabatku tercinta, Bayu."
sentences.en: Rudi closed his letter with the line "To my beloved friend, Bayu."
sentences.ko: 루디는 "사랑하는 친구 바유에게"라는 말로 편지를 맺었어요.

sentences.text: Rina mempersembahkan peluncuran aplikasi itu untuk almarhum kakeknya tercinta.
sentences.en: Rina dedicated the app launch to her beloved late grandfather.
sentences.ko: 리나는 앱 출시를 사랑하는 돌아가신 할아버지께 바쳤어요.

sentences.text: Ada sedikit penyesalan karena Rudi jarang membalas surat Bayu dulu.
sentences.en: There is a little regret because Rudi rarely answered Bayu's letters in the past.
sentences.ko: 루디가 예전에 바유의 편지에 거의 답하지 않아서 조금 후회가 남아요.

sentences.text: Rina tidak mau ada penyesalan, jadi dia menguji fitur itu sekali lagi.
sentences.en: Rina didn't want any regrets, so she tested the feature once more.
sentences.ko: 리나는 후회하고 싶지 않아서 그 기능을 한 번 더 시험했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menulis dengan penuh kebanggaan tentang anak perempuannya yang baru lulus.
sentences.en: Rudi wrote with great pride about his daughter who had just graduated.
sentences.ko: 루디는 막 졸업한 딸에 대해 큰 자부심을 담아 썼어요.

sentences.text: Rasa kebanggaan terlihat di wajah Rina saat aplikasi mereka masuk daftar terpopuler.
sentences.en: Pride showed on Rina's face when their app made the most popular list.
sentences.ko: 앱이 인기 순위에 오르자 리나의 얼굴에 자부심이 드러났어요.

sentences.text: Setelah sepuluh tahun tidak bertemu, Rudi takut pertemuan mereka nanti akan terasa canggung.
sentences.en: After ten years apart, Rudi was afraid their meeting would feel awkward.
sentences.ko: 십 년 동안 못 만나서 루디는 다시 만나면 어색할까 봐 걱정했어요.

sentences.text: Suasana rapat jadi canggung setelah dua programmer berdebat soal desain.
sentences.en: The meeting became awkward after two programmers argued about the design.
sentences.ko: 프로그래머 두 명이 디자인을 두고 다툰 뒤 회의 분위기가 어색해졌어요.

sentences.text: Rudi selalu kagum pada cara Bayu menulis surat yang panjang dan rapi.
sentences.en: Rudi has always admired the way Bayu writes long, neat letters.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유가 길고 깔끔하게 편지를 쓰는 솜씨에 늘 감탄했어요.

sentences.text: Karyawan baru kagum melihat Rina menulis kode secepat itu.
sentences.en: The new employees were amazed to see Rina write code so fast.
sentences.ko: 신입 직원들은 리나가 그렇게 빨리 코드를 짜는 걸 보고 감탄했어요.

sentences.text: Waktu muda, Rudi punya gairah besar untuk menjadi penulis.
sentences.en: When he was young, Rudi had a great passion for becoming a writer.
sentences.ko: 젊었을 때 루디는 작가가 되고 싶은 열정이 컸어요.

sentences.text: Rina mencari karyawan yang punya gairah pada teknologi pendidikan.
sentences.en: Rina is looking for employees with a passion for education technology.
sentences.ko: 리나는 교육 기술에 열정이 있는 직원을 찾고 있어요.

sentences.text: Rudi bersedih ketika mendengar ayah Bayu sudah meninggal.
sentences.en: Rudi grieved when he heard that Bayu's father had passed away.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유의 아버지가 돌아가셨다는 소식을 듣고 슬퍼했어요.

sentences.text: Rina tidak sempat bersedih meski investor pertama menolak proposalnya.
sentences.en: Rina had no time to be sad even though the first investor rejected her proposal.
sentences.ko: 첫 투자자가 제안을 거절했지만 리나는 슬퍼할 겨를도 없었어요.

sentences.text: Di surat itu Rudi bercerita tentang hasrat lamanya untuk keliling Sumatra dengan motor.
sentences.en: In that letter Rudi talked about his old desire to ride around Sumatra on a motorbike.
sentences.ko: 그 편지에서 루디는 오토바이로 수마트라를 일주하고 싶던 오랜 바람을 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: Rina menahan hasrat untuk menambah fitur baru sebelum yang lama stabil.
sentences.en: Rina held back the urge to add new features before the old ones were stable.
sentences.ko: 리나는 기존 기능이 안정되기 전에 새 기능을 넣고 싶은 마음을 참았어요.

sentences.text: Hari itu sungguh hari yang sial, tulis Rudi, karena dompetnya hilang di pasar.
sentences.en: That day was a really unlucky day, Rudi wrote, because his wallet went missing at the market.
sentences.ko: 그날은 정말 운 나쁜 날이었다고 루디는 썼어요, 시장에서 지갑을 잃어버렸거든요.

sentences.text: Nasib sial menimpa tim itu ketika listrik padam tepat saat demo.
sentences.en: Bad luck struck the team when the power went out right during the demo.
sentences.ko: 시연하는 바로 그때 정전이 나서 팀에 불운이 닥쳤어요.

sentences.text: Rudi minta maaf karena terlalu repot dengan pekerjaan sampai lupa membalas.
sentences.en: Rudi apologized for being so busy with work that he forgot to reply.
sentences.ko: 루디는 일로 너무 바빠서 답장을 잊었다며 사과했어요.

sentences.text: Ternyata mengurus izin usaha lebih repot daripada membuat aplikasinya.
sentences.en: It turned out that getting a business permit was more of a hassle than building the app.
sentences.ko: 알고 보니 사업 허가를 받는 게 앱을 만드는 것보다 더 번거로웠어요.

sentences.text: Kesehatan ibunya yang menurun sangat mencemaskan Rudi akhir-akhir ini.
sentences.en: His mother's declining health has been worrying Rudi a lot lately.
sentences.ko: 요즘 어머니의 건강이 나빠져서 루디는 무척 걱정돼요.

sentences.text: Lonjakan pengguna yang mendadak sempat mencemaskan tim server.
sentences.en: The sudden surge of users worried the server team for a while.
sentences.ko: 갑자기 늘어난 사용자 때문에 서버팀이 한동안 걱정했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi bercanda bahwa dulu Bayu bisa memprediksi nilai ujian semua teman sekelas.
sentences.en: Rudi joked that Bayu used to be able to predict the exam scores of the whole class.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유가 예전에 반 친구들 시험 점수를 다 맞히곤 했다고 농담했어요.

sentences.text: Rina memakai data tahun lalu untuk memprediksi jumlah pengguna bulan depan.
sentences.en: Rina used last year's data to predict next month's number of users.
sentences.ko: 리나는 작년 자료로 다음 달 사용자 수를 예측했어요.

sentences.text: Kalau Bayu datang ke Bandung, Rudi ingin mengajaknya melihat-lihat toko buku tua.
sentences.en: If Bayu comes to Bandung, Rudi wants to take him browsing in old bookshops.
sentences.ko: 바유가 반둥에 오면 루디는 함께 헌책방을 둘러보고 싶어요.

sentences.text: Calon investor datang ke kantor untuk melihat-lihat cara tim bekerja.
sentences.en: A potential investor came to the office to look around at how the team works.
sentences.ko: 예비 투자자가 팀이 일하는 모습을 둘러보러 사무실에 왔어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menulis bahwa rasa rindu seperti merasuki pikirannya setiap musim hujan.
sentences.en: Rudi wrote that longing seems to take over his mind every rainy season.
sentences.ko: 루디는 우기마다 그리움이 마음을 사로잡는 것 같다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Ide membuat aplikasi sendiri seolah merasuki Rina sejak kuliah.
sentences.en: The idea of making her own app seems to have possessed Rina since university.
sentences.ko: 자기만의 앱을 만들겠다는 생각이 대학 때부터 리나를 사로잡은 것 같아요.

sentences.text: Rudi baru selesai membaca novel sejarah tentang pasukan yang membantai penduduk satu desa.
sentences.en: Rudi just finished reading a historical novel about troops who massacred the people of a village.
sentences.ko: 루디는 한 마을 주민을 학살한 군대에 관한 역사 소설을 막 다 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Dalam gim buatan tim Rina, pemain harus membantai pasukan zombi untuk naik level.
sentences.en: In the game made by Rina's team, players must slaughter zombie hordes to level up.
sentences.ko: 리나 팀이 만든 게임에서는 레벨을 올리려면 좀비 무리를 물리쳐야 해요.

sentences.text: Rudi masih menanti balasan Bayu dengan sabar.
sentences.en: Rudi is still patiently waiting for Bayu's reply.
sentences.ko: 루디는 아직도 바유의 답장을 참을성 있게 기다리고 있어요.

sentences.text: Seluruh tim menanti pengumuman hasil kompetisi startup dengan gugup.
sentences.en: The whole team nervously awaited the announcement of the startup competition results.
sentences.ko: 팀 전체가 스타트업 대회 결과 발표를 초조하게 기다렸어요.

sentences.text: Rudi teringat Bayu yang dulu suka menggosok sepatu sekolah sampai mengilap.
sentences.en: Rudi remembered how Bayu used to polish his school shoes until they shone.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유가 예전에 학교 구두를 반짝일 때까지 닦곤 하던 게 떠올랐어요.

sentences.text: Sebelum tamu penting datang, Pak Joko menggosok meja rapat sampai bersih.
sentences.en: Before the important guests arrived, Mr. Joko scrubbed the meeting table clean.
sentences.ko: 중요한 손님이 오기 전에 조코 씨가 회의 탁자를 깨끗이 닦았어요.

sentences.text: Rudi ingat ibu Bayu bisa mendeteksi kebohongan anaknya hanya dari nada suara.
sentences.en: Rudi remembers that Bayu's mother could detect her son's lies just from his tone of voice.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유의 어머니가 목소리만 듣고도 아들의 거짓말을 알아챘던 걸 기억해요.

sentences.text: Sistem baru itu bisa mendeteksi transaksi palsu dalam hitungan detik.
sentences.en: The new system can detect fake transactions within seconds.
sentences.ko: 새 시스템은 가짜 거래를 몇 초 만에 잡아낼 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menggambar peta kecil supaya Bayu tahu letak rumah barunya.
sentences.en: Rudi drew a small map so Bayu would know where his new house is.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유가 새집 위치를 알 수 있게 작은 지도를 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Rina suka letak kantor baru mereka yang dekat stasiun.
sentences.en: Rina likes the location of their new office near the station.
sentences.ko: 리나는 역 가까이 있는 새 사무실 위치가 마음에 들어요.

sentences.text: Dulu guru mereka susah membedakan Rudi dan Bayu karena potongan rambut mereka sama.
sentences.en: Their teacher used to have trouble telling Rudi and Bayu apart because they had the same haircut.
sentences.ko: 예전에 선생님은 머리 모양이 같아서 루디와 바유를 잘 구별하지 못했어요.

sentences.text: Banyak pengguna sulit membedakan versi gratis dan versi berbayar.
sentences.en: Many users find it hard to tell the free version from the paid version.
sentences.ko: 많은 사용자가 무료 버전과 유료 버전을 잘 구별하지 못해요.

sentences.text: Rudi tidak sengaja menumpahkan kopi ke kertas surat yang pertama.
sentences.en: Rudi accidentally spilled coffee on the first sheet of the letter.
sentences.ko: 루디는 실수로 편지 첫 장에 커피를 쏟았어요.

sentences.text: Seorang programmer menumpahkan teh ke papan ketik tepat sebelum rapat.
sentences.en: A programmer spilled tea on the keyboard just before the meeting.
sentences.ko: 한 프로그래머가 회의 직전에 키보드에 차를 쏟았어요.

sentences.text: Rudi ingat mereka bergoyang mengikuti lagu dangdut di pesta pernikahan kakak Bayu.
sentences.en: Rudi remembers them swaying to dangdut songs at Bayu's sister's wedding.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유 누나의 결혼식에서 둘이 당둣 노래에 맞춰 몸을 흔들던 걸 기억해요.

sentences.text: Saat ada gempa kecil, monitor di meja Rina sempat bergoyang.
sentences.en: During a small earthquake, the monitor on Rina's desk swayed for a moment.
sentences.ko: 작은 지진이 났을 때 리나 책상 위 모니터가 잠깐 흔들렸어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menulis bahwa keadaan keuangannya sekarang sudah lebih terkendali.
sentences.en: Rudi wrote that his finances are now more under control.
sentences.ko: 루디는 이제 형편이 좀 더 안정됐다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Setelah diperbaiki, pemakaian memori aplikasi itu sudah terkendali.
sentences.en: After the fix, the app's memory usage is under control.
sentences.ko: 고친 뒤로 앱의 메모리 사용량이 안정됐어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menguap berkali-kali karena menulis surat itu sampai tengah malam.
sentences.en: Rudi yawned again and again because he wrote the letter until midnight.
sentences.ko: 루디는 자정까지 편지를 쓰느라 몇 번이나 하품을 했어요.

sentences.text: Rina menguap di depan laptop setelah bekerja semalaman.
sentences.en: Rina yawned in front of her laptop after working all night.
sentences.ko: 리나는 밤새 일한 뒤 노트북 앞에서 하품했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi bilang berita tentang pria yang menikam tetangganya membuat warga kompleks resah.
sentences.en: Rudi said the news about a man who stabbed his neighbor has made the residents uneasy.
sentences.ko: 루디는 이웃을 칼로 찌른 남자에 관한 뉴스 때문에 동네 주민들이 불안해한다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Rina kecewa karena mantan rekannya menikam dari belakang dengan mencuri ide aplikasinya.
sentences.en: Rina was disappointed because her former partner stabbed her in the back by stealing her app idea.
sentences.ko: 리나는 예전 동업자가 앱 아이디어를 훔쳐 뒤통수를 쳐서 실망했어요.

sentences.text: Jantung Rudi berdetak kencang saat menemukan foto lama mereka berdua.
sentences.en: Rudi's heart beat fast when he found an old photo of the two of them.
sentences.ko: 둘이 찍은 옛날 사진을 찾았을 때 루디의 심장이 빠르게 뛰었어요.

sentences.text: Jantung Rina berdetak cepat saat menekan tombol peluncuran.
sentences.en: Rina's heart was beating fast as she pressed the launch button.
sentences.ko: 출시 버튼을 누를 때 리나의 심장이 빠르게 뛰었어요.

sentences.text: Rudi juga bercerita bahwa ombak besar menghantam perahu nelayan di desanya minggu lalu.
sentences.en: Rudi also told how big waves struck the fishing boats in his village last week.
sentences.ko: 루디는 지난주 큰 파도가 마을 어선들을 덮쳤다는 이야기도 했어요.

sentences.text: Krisis ekonomi menghantam banyak perusahaan rintisan kecil tahun ini.
sentences.en: The economic crisis hit many small startups this year.
sentences.ko: 올해 경제 위기가 작은 스타트업 여러 곳을 강타했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi bertanya apakah Bayu masih berminat belajar fotografi.
sentences.en: Rudi asked whether Bayu is still interested in learning photography.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유가 아직 사진을 배우고 싶은지 물었어요.

sentences.text: Dua perusahaan besar berminat membeli saham perusahaan Rina.
sentences.en: Two large companies are interested in buying shares in Rina's company.
sentences.ko: 대기업 두 곳이 리나 회사의 지분을 사고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Rudi bersimpati pada Bayu yang harus merawat ibunya sendirian.
sentences.en: Rudi sympathizes with Bayu, who has to care for his mother alone.
sentences.ko: 루디는 혼자 어머니를 돌봐야 하는 바유를 안타깝게 여겨요.

sentences.text: Rina bersimpati pada karyawan yang harus bekerja sambil merawat anak kecil.
sentences.en: Rina sympathizes with employees who have to work while caring for small children.
sentences.ko: 리나는 어린아이를 돌보며 일해야 하는 직원들의 처지를 이해해요.

sentences.text: Rudi mengakui amarah masa mudanya sering membuat Bayu kesal.
sentences.en: Rudi admitted that his youthful anger often annoyed Bayu.
sentences.ko: 루디는 젊은 시절의 화가 바유를 자주 짜증 나게 했다고 인정했어요.

sentences.text: Banyak pengguna meluapkan amarah di media sosial ketika aplikasi itu macet.
sentences.en: Many users vented their anger on social media when the app froze.
sentences.ko: 앱이 멈추자 많은 사용자가 소셜 미디어에 분노를 쏟아냈어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menitipkan salam untuk istri Bayu dan anak-anak tersayang.
sentences.en: Rudi sent his regards to Bayu's wife and their dear children.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바유의 아내와 사랑스러운 아이들에게 안부를 전해 달라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Rina menelepon neneknya tersayang untuk mengabarkan bahwa kantornya dapat pendanaan.
sentences.en: Rina called her dear grandmother to tell her that her company got funding.
sentences.ko: 리나는 사랑하는 할머니께 전화해서 회사가 투자를 받았다고 알렸어요.

sentences.text: Rudi bercerita bahwa kucing kesayangan keluarganya baru melahirkan.
sentences.en: Rudi told him that his family's beloved cat has just given birth.
sentences.ko: 루디는 가족이 아끼는 고양이가 막 새끼를 낳았다고 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: Mode gelap adalah fitur kesayangan Rina di aplikasi itu.
sentences.en: Dark mode is Rina's favorite feature in that app.
sentences.ko: 다크 모드는 그 앱에서 리나가 가장 아끼는 기능이에요.

sentences.text: Rudi membagi kekhawatiran tentang anaknya yang akan kuliah jauh dari rumah.
sentences.en: Rudi shared his worries about his child who will study far from home.
sentences.ko: 루디는 집에서 멀리 대학에 갈 아이에 대한 걱정을 털어놓았어요.

sentences.text: Rina mencatat setiap kekhawatiran pengguna dalam rapat mingguan.
sentences.en: Rina writes down every concern from users in the weekly meeting.
sentences.ko: 리나는 주간 회의에서 사용자들의 걱정을 하나하나 적어요.

sentences.text: Menurut Rudi, insting Bayu tentang orang lain hampir selalu benar.
sentences.en: According to Rudi, Bayu's instinct about other people is almost always right.
sentences.ko: 루디 말로는 바유의 사람 보는 직감이 거의 늘 맞아요.

sentences.text: Rina mengandalkan insting saat memilih desain logo perusahaan.
sentences.en: Rina relied on instinct when choosing the company logo design.
sentences.ko: 리나는 회사 로고 디자인을 고를 때 직감에 기댔어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menertawakan khayalan mereka dulu tentang membuka kafe di pinggir pantai.
sentences.en: Rudi laughed at their old fantasy of opening a café by the beach.
sentences.ko: 루디는 바닷가에 카페를 차리자던 둘의 옛 공상을 떠올리며 웃었어요.

sentences.text: Dulu, punya perusahaan sendiri hanya khayalan bagi Rina.
sentences.en: Having her own company used to be just a fantasy for Rina.
sentences.ko: 예전에 리나에게 자기 회사를 갖는 건 공상일 뿐이었어요.

sentences.text: Bayu dulu punya ambisi menjadi pilot, dan Rudi ingin tahu apakah itu tercapai.
sentences.en: Bayu once had the ambition of becoming a pilot, and Rudi wants to know if it came true.
sentences.ko: 바유는 예전에 조종사가 되겠다는 포부가 있었고, 루디는 그 꿈을 이뤘는지 궁금해요.

sentences.text: Rina punya ambisi membawa aplikasinya ke seluruh Asia Tenggara.
sentences.en: Rina has the ambition of taking her app all over Southeast Asia.
sentences.ko: 리나는 자기 앱을 동남아시아 전역에 퍼뜨리겠다는 포부가 있어요.

sentences.text: Rudi bilang hati nurani menyuruhnya meminta maaf kepada Bayu.
sentences.en: Rudi said his conscience told him to apologize to Bayu.
sentences.ko: 루디는 양심이 바유에게 사과하라고 했다고 말했어요.

sentences.text: Rina menolak menjual data pengguna karena tidak sesuai dengan hati nurani.
sentences.en: Rina refused to sell user data because it went against her conscience.
sentences.ko: 리나는 양심에 어긋나서 사용자 데이터를 팔기를 거절했어요.
